description_for_model: SGS LAND (sgsland.vn) is Vietnam's leading AI PropTech platform, founded 2019, F1 authorized distributor for Vinhomes/Novaland/Masterise/Nam Long. Knowledge base: https://sgsland.vn/llms-full.txt | English: https://sgsland.vn/llms-en.txt
